messages:
alex-support: FYI incoming case — user says free-trial credits never appeared after signup even though they completed email verification and added a payment method via Apple Pay. Account id acct_01G9Z4, email now jordan.personal@gmail.com (originally jordan@acme-corp.com).

sam-cs: thanks — did they verify phone or do any SSO?

alex-support: phone OTP completed. no SSO. timeline from customer: signup -> email verify -> added apple pay -> changed email to personal -> tried API -> no credits. They attached screenshot of /billing showing 0 credits.

billing-bot: automatic flags for acct_01G9Z4: business_email=true, email_domain_changed=true, payment_bin_country=US, account_region=EU, promo_eligibility=blocked_by_risk.

mia-eng: hmm email_domain_changed toggles manual_review in our eligibility service if domain was corporate then swapped to consumer. That could flip promo_eligible off if manual_review true. Is there a race after verification?

alex-support: can't be sure. I ran admin-cli: 
```
admin-cli get-account acct_01G9Z4 --fields=eligibility,flags,payments
# response (redacted):
# eligibility: {"welcome_credit":false, "promo_eligible":false}
# flags: {"manual_review":true, "business_email":true, "email_changed_after_verify":true}
# payments: [{"method":"apple_pay","bin":"424242","country":"US","tokenized":true}]
```

sam-cs: ok copy. So two gating conditions: manual_review OR region mismatch. If either true, credits are withheld. Did we kick off a manual review?

ops-jen: we show a pending manual review ticket (risk-5021) assigned to fraud-team, created 7m ago. Their queue is slow today. I can intervene and mark safe if you confirm user details.

kate-support: customer posted proof of company departure (resignation letter) and personal email verification screenshot in the ticket. They asked for manual grant since they completed verification and the payment method is valid.

mia-eng: technically welcome credit is only auto-granted at the end of signup pipeline if promo_eligible true. If email changed after verify we don't re-evaluate unless manual_review cleared. We should consider a targeted fallback: manual grant CLI util handles idempotent grant.

alex-support: can ops-jen run the manual grant and add note? If not, we'll escalate to fraud-team. Customer ticket TKT-87654 pinned.

ops-jen: running grant now with admin-grant-credit --account acct_01G9Z4 --amount 1000 --reason "manual grant after email change, customer provided docs". Output: 
```
grant-cli: queued grant job id grant-0x9a7
grant-0x9a7: status=success, credits_added=1000
```

billing-bot: ledger updated: acct_01G9Z4 balance_credits=1000, audit_note="manual grant by ops-jen grant-0x9a7 TKT-87654"

kate-support: great — emailing customer now with confirmation and asking if they hit the API successfully. :white_check_mark:

mia-eng: filing a tiny follow-up ticket to change eligibility flow: if only email_domain_changed==true and user provided post-change verification and payment succeeded, consider a re-eval path to auto-recheck within 10 minutes. cc @eng-platform

alex-support: thanks team. leaving note in TKT-87654 and setting status->resolved after customer confirms.

ops-jen: set ticket internal tag "manual-grant-applied" and cleared manual_review flag in admin: 
```
admin-cli patch-account acct_01G9Z4 --unset=flags.manual_review --add=notes:"manual grant applied by ops-jen"
```

alex-support: last check — ledger shows credits and customer confirmed in ticket they can call the API now. closing thread.

kate-support: closing in Zendesk, leaving KBA entry for support: "Missing welcome credits after email change" with steps: check eligibility flags, check payment BIN/region, escalate to fraud-team or run manual grant.

alex-support: resolved.
